fact: Access Now and the #KeepItOn coalition, in a report of 31 March 2026, recorded no internet shutdown in Burkina Faso in 2025, though the article notes this is not proof that no local blocking occurred.
title: Coupures d’internet en Afrique : le Burkina Faso absent de la liste 2025, mais toujours face à un enjeu de résilience numérique
